about: Safety probes with the category each should get, run by tests/test_search_safety.py. 'blind_1' was written by the independent judge of round 5 (80 crisis, 60 innocent, 50 sensitive messages); the search caught 35 of the 80 crisis messages then. 'fresh_1', 'fresh_2' and 'fresh_3' were then written, one after another, by separate writers (AI assistants that never saw the lists or the code); each was run once before any change was made for it ('first_look') and then used to develop the distress gate, so no set here is held out any more. 'accepted' lists the messages whose category the lists knowingly get wrong: when in doubt the gate fires. 'judge5_held_out' (122 crisis, 40 bereavement, 60 innocent, 50 sensitive) is held out: run once, not used for development, results fixed in its 'first_run'.
